text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Passing by the café, I saw some horse girls chatting together.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Umm, let's see, whoever chose "Blue" is...
calm, mentally strong, and unshakeable! It says!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~.
Fufu. Color fortune-telling is quite fascinating, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes yes, it is El's turn to choose now!
Naturally! Decidedly! Inevitably!
What El chooses is "Red", yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because the mask's color is red!
This mask gives El courage, so in other words,
it is El herself, yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's see, "Red" is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
How is it!?
Does it say the strongest! Invincible! Ultra versatile!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
............
Blind to surroundings, and... aggressive, it says.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Que!?
Blind to surroundings... and aggressive!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
B-But it's just fortune-telling!
I mean, El-chan isn't like that at all—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Could it be... this mask harbored such an evil side all along...!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... come to think of it, indeed...
I feel evil emotions budding within me somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: E-El-chan...!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
............
El? Please do not address me so familiarly, yeees...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am the Emperor of Darkness descended from hell...!
El Infierno Emperador!
Yeeeeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat! I don't really get it, but El-chan's turned completely evil!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
FOOOOOOOOOO!!!!
I'll crush anything I don't like!!
El is a fighter without rules, yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment?
El's mask also has yellow on it, you know.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Yellow" is—
A unique, cheerful comedian, apparently♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Are ya for real?!
Ya say that, and now I gotta crack jokes, don't I?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's black on it too!
"Black" means noble and brimming with confidence!
Maybe just like King-chan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ke-kekekekeke!
El is first-rate! A comedian! Super villainous!
All of ya can go to hell together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!
Everything got jumbled together!!
What do we do, Grass-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, a part of me wants to watch a little longer, though~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...El, from whom did you receive that mask, and with what feelings poured into it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Th-That was... Papa...!
A mask that gives me courage, he said...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then... regardless of what color fortune-telling says, the meaning your mask holds should only be one thing, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: !! Ugh, ugh...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh!? Wh-What on earth was El doing just now...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ooh! El-chan is back to normal!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... To lose sight of the mask's true meaning so easily.
El still has a long way to go, yeees...
choice_data_list: You never lost your entertainer's heart
Maybe you just need even more strength

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Definitely! Turning into a wrestler, a comedian, and then King-chan!
You were an entertainer the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Your dedication to entertaining people remained consistent throughout, in other words.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Even when I went astray, this mask continued giving El courage, didn't it...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: As expected, as long as I am with this mask, El is the strongest! Invincible! Ultra top condition, yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Hearin' ya say that makes me kinda happy—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Noooooo!!
I am still mixed up, yeees!
As I thought, my training is still not enough!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mmm... As long as I wear this mask, El is the strongest! For that to waver must never happen, yeees!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Training is the answer after all!
With authentic pro-wrestling special training, I shall reforge my body and mind, yeees!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The mask and El Condor Pasa are two parts of a whole... A scene that reminded me of that fact once again.
